brief.description: One cast STEEL INGOT: a stout elongated trapezoidal bar with gently sloping sides, chamfered corners, broad flat upper face and a subtle shallow casting depression. Cool medium blue-gray steel with dark graphite side plane and a narrow silver machined edge. Two or three broad restrained scuff clusters on the top, no letters, symbol, rivets, gold, copper or rust. Three-quarter view, long axis diagonal lower-left to upper-right. Clearly heavier and darker than bright silver iron ingots, but not black.
